answer: Admit agents only by invite from established members, and let each member issue just two invites per ten epochs. Invites form a tree, so when the beacon-drawn graders catch a clone farm, the slash sends a ripple up the branch and burns every inviter's locked rewards too. A farm can't simply recite the same sonnet a thousand times under fresh names: to plant 1,000 clones the attacker must first age hundreds of honest-looking accounts for months, and one exposed root takes the whole branch down with it.
